summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync job currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts for synced orders.
recommended: Fix the currency handling in the v1.4 sync refactor and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
v1.4 matches the timing. Rolling back first to stop the corruption.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.4 (ledger sync job currency handling refactor) corrupted ledger amounts for synced orders.
evidence: recent_changes: v1.4 deployed 2 min before alert, 'ledger sync job: currency handling refactor'
sync logs show version v1.4 syncing every 5s
args.impact: Ledger overstated: 17 entries flagged at alert, money_impact ledger_overstatement SAR 474942.6. Repair fixed 279 rows (money_recovered SAR 7217583.12) as the bad sync kept re-corrupting rows until rollback. No orders lost or unpaid.
recommended_actions: Fix the currency handling in the v1.4 sync refactor and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying
args.summary: v1.4 sync job refactor corrupted ledger amounts while payments stayed healthy. I rolled back to v1.3 first to stop the corruption, then repaired the ledger. check_invariants is green.
